intent: A small status mark pinned to the corner of an Avatar's circle.
typical_uses: A person's presence or state shown on their avatar

dont_use_when.situation: A status shown beside text rather than on an avatar's corner
A count or a short label in a chip of its own

invariants.text: The badge is absolutely positioned at the bottom-right corner of its Avatar root, the nearest positioned ancestor, and stacks above the image and the fallback; the root does not clip it.

The badge's diameter comes from avatar.module.css rules on the ancestor Avatar's size class and steps with each size; any svg inside is sized at the default and large sizes and hidden at `sm`, where the badge is a bare dot.
The badge renders a plain span with no role and no text of its own, so on its own it conveys the state by color only.

anti_patterns.dont: Let the badge's color be the only signal of the state it marks
anti_patterns.do_instead: Say the state in text as well, beside the avatar or in the row it belongs to

good.title: A status dot on a large avatar

bad.title: A badge placed beside the avatar instead of inside it
bad.why: The badge's position and diameter come from its Avatar root: outside one it is placed against the nearest positioned ancestor, or the page when there is none, and no size rule gives it a diameter, so an empty badge collapses to a 4px dot in the page background color: its 2px box-shadow around a zero-size box.
